item.name: Get Project By Slug Or Id

request.description:
## Schema

### Params
- `slugOrId` (string) slug or Mongo ObjectId

### Response 200 — Project (full)
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["message", "data"],
  "properties": {
    "message": { "type": "string" },
    "data": { "$ref": "#/Project" }
  }
}
```

### Project
```json
{
  "_id": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "slug": "string",
  "image": "string (url)",
  "overview": "string",
  "date": "date",
  "address": "string",
  "location": "string (city lowercase)",
  "client": "string",
  "contractValue": "string",
  "service": "construction|infrastructure|transportation",
  "keyFeatures": {
    "image": "string (url)",
    "sections": [
      {
        "title": "string",
        "value": "string (optional metric)",
        "items": ["string"] 
      }
    ]
  },
  "isActive": "boolean",
  "createdAt": "date-time",
  "updatedAt": "date-time"
}
```

Public: active only. Admin Bearer: can load inactive.

Auth: optional Bearer

## Schema

### Params
- `id` (ObjectId) required

### Request (all fields optional)
Same properties as Create Project.

### Response 200
```json
{
  "message": "Project updated successfully",
  "data": { "$ref": "#/Project" }
}
```

Auth: Bearer required

## Schema

### Params
- `id` (ObjectId) required

### Response 204
Empty body

Auth: Bearer required
